profile_text.body:
# Meta

Meta describes itself as building AI models and tools for developers. The company offers access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API, with resources for developers to get started. It positions Muse as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, performing competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The Meta Model API is OpenAI SDK compatible and includes search grounding capabilities to give models live access to the web. Muse Image, available on Meta Model API at $0.01/image, is described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing with anchored composition for consistent edits.

Meta's core tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family often self-hosted. The company, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the year ended 2025-12-31. Meta is a public company with ticker META and CIK 0001326801.

The company faces three active lawsuits: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court of the Western District of Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California. Meta has 220 cases with law exposure in California. Seven MCP servers have been registered for Meta's systems, including tools for Meta Ads automation, AI research corpus access, avatar creation, and workspace control.
